reflection.assumptions: The impact of the pandemic and the legacy of Ebola should be understood through how participants describe changes in healthcare, perceptions of risk, institutional responses, and everyday experiences during public health crises.

coding_output:
Initial Code: Patient experiences barriers to accessing healthcare  
Clues: "People were having this concept that it won’t be treated by the English way unless I go for traditional native medicines that the only it could be treated. ... I saw no improvements that’s when I decided to go to the hospital."  
Initial Code: Perception of COVID-19 as a serious threat  
Clues: "Corona is real and that why the precautions that the government has put in place that the whole world has put in place they said we should abide by them, it real."  
Initial Code: Government measures impact daily life  
Clues: "It one of the measures that government really put in place like the face mask and all of cause it affected people especially those with asthma diseases... it was affecting us especially the lockdown for the disables and vulnerable it was affecting them."  
Initial Code: Educational disruptions due to school closures  
Clues: "when school was closed look at the results that came out because schools closed earlier then second term school was closed... there was no studies no caring was there."  
Initial Code: Transportation challenges during lockdown  
Clues: "well there was no transportation, especially district lockdown transportation was high, and the people with money travels only... the transport fare from here to Freetown they were asking for le 150,000 can you imagine?"  
Initial Code: Social isolation during lockdown  
Clues: "the biggest challenge was this face mask and lockdown because the day when you say lockdown people that has the chance you see them buying things for their homes... but for us here now they will just lock us in they will not feed us."  
Initial Code: Restrictions on social interactions during the pandemic  
Clues: "we were not interacting, we were not visiting no one, even when you visit someone he or she will tell you no go to your own house, so that how they were telling us." "yes we restrict ourselves." "the increase in number of death. Of cause the death was low but the number of affected people was increasing so that was making everyone scared..."  
Initial Code: Comparison of government responses between Ebola and COVID-19  
Clues: "during the time of EBOLA the restriction was there but it was not that much, and for that made people to come here because we had no experience." "as compared to this one before it came government had blocked all the borders and all the districts." "the lockdown was enormous like in that time it was two times that we had lockdown 3 times..."  
Initial Code: Increased adherence to government guidelines during COVID-19  
Clues: "yes because they enforced it, they enforced the measures, you don’t abide, and they fine a levy on you." "They put it right on every districts to the chiefdoms they involve all the stakeholders so the fight was a national fight..." "the previous government they have already know although they still don’t have measures but as time goes now they said let put certain restriction in place..."  
Initial Code: Legacy of Ebola influencing COVID-19 response  
Clues: "the EBOLA outbreak helped you and your community to prepare for this COVID?" "exactly." "now when the COVID is here the previous government they have already know although they still don’t have measures..."  
Initial Code: Perception of government effectiveness in managing the pandemic  
Clues: "much, more better" "the first case that they presented on that day... he lock the districts of cause the restriction the sensitization was there..." "so the thing didn’t escalate to that level."  
Initial Code: Government's early response to COVID-19  
Clues: "they attack the disease earlier. ... government announces it, so they have given their own measures..."  
Initial Code: Lack of timely payment for healthcare workers  
Clues: "the soldiers that were on the forefront it reach at a time the salary time they didn’t pay them... they didn’t look to them quickly..."  
Initial Code: Insufficient availability of essential drugs in hospitals  
Clues: "...certain drugs you need in the hospital, unless they refer you to another facility... the drugs that I needed... it wasn’t available..."  
Initial Code: Poor sanitation and infrastructure in government hospitals  
Clues: "the toilet facility sanitation. Government hospital has no toilet facility... if you are not careful you will come out again with another diseases..."  
Initial Code: Increased healthcare costs during the pandemic  
Clues: "initially when I went to the finance doctor told me go and pay to that woman... from 2015 to 2020 automatically they have given me le 500,000 for 2015 for hernia then when I went there... le 1,200,000 for the same operation..."  
Initial Code: Variability in quality of care between public and private hospitals  
Clues: "the nurses in the private hospital are more caring... unlike for government hospital a lot of noise..."  
Initial Code: Personal connections influencing healthcare experiences  
Clues: "...I will make sure I have a good relation. So me and doctor [retracted] has had that good relations..."  
Initial Code: Perceived government accountability for healthcare improvements  
Clues: "government should try to improve on the health centers, more improvement on the health system..."  
Initial Code: Patient feels satisfied with surgical care during COVID
Clues: "really, really I satisfied with the care, till now and Thursday I should go for checkup because that what the doctor told me." 
Initial Code: Patient perceives differences in care between COVID and surgical patients
Clues: "yes because they are pandemic. They already has it so they should put more premium on them but surgical they should also put premium they should care for us..." 
Initial Code: Patient expresses concern about funding disparities for COVID vs. surgical care
Clues: "they pour more money on COVID but we never saw donor for operation (laughing)" 
Initial Code: Patient acknowledges increased risk and compensation for health workers during COVID
Clues: "they are giving them extra payments is that not so? The health workers have extra besides what they paid them because if catches you, you have risk your life..." 
Initial Code: Patient emphasizes the need for improvements in hospital facilities
Clues: "they should improve on the monitoring not only the buildings like all the facilities more especially the drugs should be available in the hospitals." 
Initial Code: Patient suggests the need for preventive measures in future outbreaks
Clues: "Let have that kind of system let them inject you with an Anti-drugs with all the ones that are not infected..." 
Initial Code: Patient indicates fear of visiting hospitals due to COVID
Clues: "people were having other diseases which is not EBOLA but they are afraid to go to the hospital."
